task.targets: five independent error labels; union of primary and additional; correct=all zeros

data.source: REHAB26-ViewAngles processed_v1; reuse only after hash and schema verification

split.inner: rotate each of the other four people as validation, train on remaining three
split.group_unit: subject; keep all cameras, repetitions and exercises together
split.selection: hyperparameters selected only by inner validation; average the four inner-model probabilities for each seed on the outer test person; never select an inner model by test score
split.thresholds: per-inner-model validation only; aggregate decision as mean(p_j - threshold_j)>=0 across four inner models, not mean(p) vs mean calibrated probability
split.comparison: all candidate models use the same four-inner-model aggregation; also report inner-model results and compute cost
split.evidence_status: exploratory: all five subjects appeared in previously inspected tests; independent confirmation requires new subjects or a compatible external dataset

preprocessing.channels: xyz plus visibility; visibility is not coordinate
preprocessing.geometry: subtract per-frame hip midpoint; divide by per-repetition median torso length; no per-frame rotation alignment
preprocessing.resampling: 96 frames; xyz linear interpolation; visibility minimum of adjacent source frames; same as v1
preprocessing.standardization: fit per-channel mean/std on current inner-training people only across observations/time; std floor=1e-4; validation/test reuse saved values; visibility remains [0,1] when present
preprocessing.invalid_input: reject nonfinite/full-zero frames or degenerate scale; log rejection counts; no silent zero-imputation
preprocessing.padding: none with fixed 96 frames; variable-length extension requires attention and pooling masks
preprocessing.duration: not a reference feature; resampling removes absolute duration

model.norm: Pre-LayerNorm, eps=1e-5; final LayerNorm after last block
model.activation: GELU in FFN and classifier hidden layer
model.attention_softmax: over temporal keys; scale QK^T by sqrt(16)
model.pooling: concatenate time mean and max -> B,128
model.training_output: raw logits B,5; no sigmoid before BCEWithLogitsLoss
model.inference_output: sigmoid scores; not assumed calibrated probabilities
model.post_norm_probe: matched-depth Post-LN with final LayerNorm retained; record precise topology

training.reference_loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss, unweighted, mean over batch and five labels
training.weight_source: current inner-training labels only; fail if any positive count is zero
training.decay_groups: decay Linear/attention weight matrices only; no decay for biases or LayerNorm scale/bias
training.schedule: linear warmup from lr/5 to lr, then cosine decay to 1e-5; step after each epoch
training.early_stopping: start patience after epoch 5; max validation macro average precision, min_delta=1e-4, patience=12, ties earliest checkpoint
training.checkpoint_comparison: same validation macro-AP criterion across loss probes; objective loss values from different losses are not directly comparable
training.initialization: independently initialize each encoder layer; do not leave cloned layers identically initialized; record seed and initialization policy
training.reproducibility: seed Python/NumPy/PyTorch/DataLoader; deterministic mode; record CUDA/cuDNN/TF32 settings and unsupported deterministic ops

ablation_plan.A_fairness: historical v1 values are context only; rerun matched folds/seeds/preprocessing/thresholds; TCN ReLU+GroupNorm vs Transformer GELU+LayerNorm is an architecture-package comparison
C_one_factor_probes: GELU -> ReLU everywhere hidden activation is used
training-fitted z-score -> no feature z-score, keep geometry normalization
ablation_plan.D_optional: only after A-C: one prespecified label-preserving perturbation; evaluate clean and fixed synthetic-noise sets separately
ablation_plan.budget: stagewise, not a Cartesian grid; carry configurations forward by aggregated inner-validation evidence only; no test-score-driven progression
ablation_plan.scope: A-C are proposed; freeze the exact run list before training; traditional baselines do not receive fictitious random-seed variability if deterministic

decision.primary_threshold: for each label, maximize validation F1 on 0.05:0.05:0.95; ties nearest 0.5, then lower threshold; inner-specific only
decision.calibration: none in reference; weighting can shift scores; reserve dedicated validation/calibration design before claiming calibrated confidence
decision.abstention: secondary, not yet specified; threshold distance alone is not calibrated uncertainty; always report all-sample results and rejected fraction; do not equate no detected error with verified correctness

secondary: validation-selected recall operating point with test recall and false-alert rate both reported
parameters, peak VRAM, batch=1 latency with warmup and CUDA synchronization
evaluation.uncertainty: report subject/seed distributions separately; five people do not provide strong clinical precision; no independent-sample CI over camera observations
evaluation.future_external: new unseen people or compatible real-patient data; no clinical efficacy claim from present simulated errors
